mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) can potentiate amlodipine's vasodilatory effects and increase risk of hypertensive crisis if combined with sympathomimetic amines, plus additive CNS effects and potential serotonin syndrome with certain drug combinations.
action: Use combination cautiously; monitor blood pressure closely, avoid sympathomimetic agents, and counsel patient on dietary tyramine restriction; consider alternative antihypertensive if possible.
